newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks to open Philippines coffee outlet.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks to open Philippines coffee outlet.

text.p: Starbucks Coffee International said on Thursday it signed a licensing agreement with Rustan Coffee Corp to develop Starbucks retail business in the Philippines.
The first Starbucks store is scheduled to open in Manila in late 1997, the company said in a statement.
The Philippines represents Starbucks third venture in Asia. Starbucks opened a store in Japan in August 1996, followed by a Singapore location in December 1996.
Rustan's Group of Companies owns and operates supermarkets, department stores, gourmet/delis cafes and specialty retail stores in the Phillipines.
Seattle-based Starbucks is the largest specialty coffee retailer in the U.S. with more than 1,000 retail locations in North America.
